title: Print page
summary: A page whose document is the only thing that prints: a statement, a sheet of labels, a count sheet. On screen it is a paper-like sheet under a toolbar (flat on a phone); in print the toolbar, anything marked data-screen-only and the app shell's header, footer and nav disappear, @page size and margins come from props, and pk-card, pk-field-list, pk-property-grid, pk-field-group and figure stay whole while a pk-table keeps whole rows and repeats its header on every page. While connected the element adopts one constructed stylesheet onto the document (CSP-safe) and removes it when it leaves.

props.name: size
props.description: The CSS @page size: a paper name, optionally with an orientation ("A4", "letter landscape") or two lengths. Empty leaves the printer default. Only letters, digits, spaces, dots, percent signs and dashes are accepted.

props.name: margin
props.description: The CSS @page margin (one to four lengths, for example "15mm" or "20mm 15mm").

slots.name: toolbar
slots.description: Screen-only actions (print, back). Hidden when printing.

slots.name: title
slots.description: The page title: a level 1 pk-heading the built-in page factory (mountTitled) appends, so the app can focus it after navigation. It prints as part of the page.
The document: the only content that prints. Mark any part of it that should not print with the data-screen-only attribute.

parts.name: toolbar
parts.description: Wraps the toolbar slot; not printed.

parts.name: sheet
parts.description: Wraps the document: a paper-like sheet on screen (a phone gets it flat and full width), bare in print.

cssProperties.name: --pk-print-page-width
cssProperties.description: Width of the sheet on screen (default 48rem).

a11y: The toolbar comes before the document in reading order and keeps its own controls' names; nothing is added to the document's semantics. Print output uses the real DOM, so headings, tables and lists keep their structure.

examples.title: A statement with a screen-only toolbar
examples.html:
Print Statement, October

Balance due 1,240.00

Not printed: use the toolbar to print this page.
